## Checks

- [ ] `swift test` passes
- [ ] Anything that removes, moves or stops goes through the policy engine, is audited and has tests on fixtures
- [ ] The setting or action exists in both the app and the `pepel` command line
- [ ] New texts are localizable and have a Russian translation (`Scripts/sync-strings.sh`)
- [ ] README or docs updated when commands, settings or behaviour change
